'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|You know what hasn't changed since the peace times? This whole Christmas mess. Everyone's stocking up on groceries like it's the last time. And even normal-looking people get the stupid idea of cutting down a live tree in the forest for their celebrations. These savages can't even tell the difference between a 200-year-old juniper and the weeds in their backyards. So they come into my woods at night in groups. I can't shoot them all by myself. I need help. You seem like an alright kid, and you're a good shot, too. Can you help me save this nature reserve?}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate any 5 targets in the forest area in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on [[Woods]]
* Eliminate any 5 targets in the forest area in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on [[Shoreline]]
* Eliminate any 5 targets in the forest area in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on [[Lighthouse]]
* Eliminate any 5 targets in the forest area in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on [[Customs]]

==Rewards==
* +9,400 [[EXP]]
* [[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 65,000 Roubles
** 68,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1
** 74,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Vortex Razor HD Gen.2 1-6x24 30mm riflescope]]
{{quote|Good, good! Now they'll think ten times before going to my forest for Christmas trees. Just go to IDEA for your stupid plastic ones. They have no business in my nature reserve.}}

==Guide==
All areas covered with trees count for the kills.
